payload.reason: The evidence provides metrics for evaluating performance differences, including character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR), which can explain the observed differences in performance between the DICTA test set and the new test set.

claims.text: The difference in performance between the DICTA test set and the new test set can be attributed to the metrics used for evaluation, specifically character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR).
Character accuracy (CHA) measures the correctness of individual characters, while word accuracy (WOR) assesses the correctness of entire words, which can lead to different performance outcomes.
